{{Top|leg}}
'''Stabattz''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Stabattz commented on the entry for the [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanical Products]] [[UniSlice]], remarking that it was an older design from the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
